The figure has no hair or visible features other than the eyes, giving it a mysterious and somewhat eerie appearance. The background is a gradient of light colors, primarily white and blue, which creates a glowing effect around the figure. The text "to be violent" is prominently displayed in bold, white letters across the center of the image, suggesting a theme or message related to the content of the video.
